svg.title: YHWH Rofekha: the LORD your healer
svg.desc: YHWH Rofekha, יְהוָה רֹפְאֶךָ: the LORD your healer. for I am the LORD, your healer. (Exodus 15:26 (ESV)). In the scene: the bitter water of Marah, and the log thrown in (Exodus 15:23-25); Moses cried to the LORD (15:25); Elim's twelve springs and seventy palm trees, all drawn (15:27).
svg.text: for I am the LORD, your healer.
In the scene: the bitter water of Marah, and the log thrown in (Exodus 15:23-25); Moses cried to the
LORD (15:25); Elim's twelve springs and seventy palm trees, all drawn (15:27).
